events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, with the US showing military strength but also its waning geopolitical power. events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased volatility in the markets, with the US facing challenges in containing great powers. This will lead to a surge in demand for safe-haven assets, such as gold, and a decline in emerging markets.
